name: obto
description: Build, deploy, and operate apps on the OBTO platform — bundles connections to BOTH OBTO clusters (app.obto.co and the SOFOS education cluster), a /obto:start cluster-picker command, plus skills for the build loop, large-file deploys (patch-in-place, chunked, and deploy-by-reference), media/binary upload (signed-URL and chunked), agent memory, per-tenant MCP extension (custom tools, resources, prompts), report-card editing (SOFOS grade pipeline + SSR components), and troubleshooting.
